From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-12-01T15:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Reranking model fit + next steps

Hi Sarah — great to meet earlier today. Thanks for the overview of Acme's search pipeline and the specific pain around discovery conversions for product pages. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

Summary from our call:
- Current stack: BM25 retrieval + heuristic re-score (business rules).
- Key metric: purchase-conversion after search click (primary), CTR and time-to-first-click (secondary).
- Typical query length: 2-6 tokens, but product attribute queries can be 8-12 tokens.
- Data constraints: no PII in logs, but product descriptions contain proprietary specs (will require logging policy for eval environment).

What Redwood recommends for initial validation:
1) Offline eval: run reranking candidates on your held-out labeled set (we discussed ~5k queries) and compute NDCG@10 / MRR@10. 
2) Models to try: rtr-rerank-large (float16), rtr-rerank-small-quant (8-bit) for a cost/latency tradeoff.
3) A/B plan: 10% traffic ramp to rerank model vs control BM25+heuristic for 2 weeks, evaluate NDCG, CTR, and downstream conversion.

Immediate asks from Acme: 
- Can you share the sample prompt set / labeled queries you referenced? (We can take a first pass locally.)
- Do you have a sandbox org or a staging endpoint we can use for the canary?

I attached a cleaned prompt set you can drop into your eval harness (acme_prompt_set_v2.csv). I also pasted a short validation checklist below.

Validation checklist (what we'll run for the offline pass):
- Run rtr-rerank-large and rtr-rerank-small-quant on the 5k eval queries.
- Compute NDCG@1/3/10 and MRR@10.
- Do a head-to-head qualitative review on the top 50 queries (business-specified topics).
- Run the same evaluation with your current production ranking for an apples-to-apples baseline.

Next steps (proposed timeline):
- You share sample labels + staging access by EOD Fri (Dec 4).
- Redwood delivers offline NDCG/MRR summary (initial) within 48 hours of receiving data.
- Align on A/B rollout plan (if offline results look promising).

If that looks right I'll loop in Rishi (re-ranking lead) and Logan (solutions engineer) to coordinate the eval infra and the canary setup.

Thanks — talk soon,

Marissa Cole

Great — thanks for the quick reply, Sarah. Answers inline and a short plan of action.

Latency expectations:
- rtr-rerank-large (float16) on a single A100-class GPU: expected p50 ~25-40ms, p95 ~80-120ms for typical query sizes (2-12 tokens) when using our batching + KV cache.
- rtr-rerank-small-quant (8-bit): expected p50 ~12-25ms, p95 ~40-70ms; lower cost but slightly lower NDCG in our baseline.

Quality/regression guardrails:
- Canary policy: automatic rollback if primary KPI (CTR) drops by >2% at 24h AND NDCG@10 offline delta < +0.5% (i.e., offline gains must precede rollout).
- Built-in diagnostics: token-level traces, top-50 mismatch inspector, and example-level re-rank diffs (we'll surface the worst regressions).

Proposed evaluation plan (we can run this as soon as you share the eval set and staging access):
1) Offline: run both models on 5k queries, compute NDCG@1/3/10 and MRR@10. I attached a short summary template (ndcg_mrr_summary.pdf) with the metrics we'll deliver.
2) Qual review: product team + CS review top 50 mismatches.
3) Canary: 10% traffic, 3-day hold with daily check; ramp to 30% if no negative signals.

Preliminary offline numbers (from a similar retailer eval):
- baseline BM25+heuristic: NDCG@10 = 0.412, MRR@10 = 0.287
- rtr-rerank-small-quant: NDCG@10 = 0.456 (+4.4%), MRR@10 = 0.314 (+9.4%)
- rtr-rerank-large: NDCG@10 = 0.482 (+7.0%), MRR@10 = 0.338 (+17.8%)

Those deltas map reasonably well to downstream CTR/conv gains in our prior customers, but your product taxonomy and label definition will influence absolute numbers — hence the offline pass.

Next steps: 
- Sarah: please share the anonymized labels + staging access link by EOD Fri (Dec 4).
- Rishi & Logan: can you confirm the offline run ETA and whether we need any special adapters to ingest Acme's CSV?

Thanks — looping you both in.

Best,
Marissa

Attachment: ndcg_mrr_summary.pdf (PDF, 38 KB)

Marissa / Logan — quick note on the validation plan and timing.

Validation approach (offline):
- Run both models on the provided 5k queries (or larger if available). We'll compute: NDCG@1/3/10, MRR@10, and position-wise delta histograms. We'll also compute per-query confidence intervals (bootstrap) to estimate significance at the 5k sample size.
- Expected wall time: ~2-3 hours for rtr-rerank-large across the set on a single GPU (we'll parallelize if they provide more nodes).
- Deliverable: ndcg_mrr_summary.pdf filled + top-50 mismatch spreadsheet + example diffs for up to 200 cases.

A/B plan technical notes:
- Canary gating: use real-time sampling + difference-in-differences on CTR with daily aggregation. If CTR delta < -2% AND offline NDCG delta not positive, auto-roll back to control.
- Fallbacks: model variant selection (large vs quant) can be automated based on p95 latency budget per route.

I'll start the adapter work once we have the CSV format. Logan — can you confirm the ingestion specs and whether the staging VPC subnet info Sarah will provide is enough to spin up the canary?

Rishi
